intro: Since the 1990s Vietnam has turned from one of the poorest countries into a manufacturing powerhouse.

chapters.title: Factory of the world
text: Vietnam makes a huge share of the world's smartphones, clothes, shoes and furniture. Samsung makes many of its phones there.
It is also one of the biggest exporters of rice, coffee, cashews and black pepper.

chapters.title: Fast growth
text: Poverty has fallen dramatically. Tourism to places like Hội An and Hạ Long Bay has boomed, and VinFast makes electric cars.

cardGroups.title: Made in Vietnam
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Vietnam makes and sells to the world.
